history.summary: An older (1999) freehold in Hillview D23 with a large 1,270 sqft 2BR asking only $1,252 PSF — a striking 19% under the $1,542 median, with a solid 4.54%/yr rate on 49 transactions. The deep discount is partly explained by the oversized unit and 27-year age, but the value and decent appreciation make it a defensible Neutral leaning constructive.
history.rating_rationale: $1,252 vs $1,542 median = -19% is the deepest discount in the batch, and 4.54%/yr on a robust 49-txn series is genuinely good. But 1,270 sqft for a 2BR is oversized, so part of the cheap PSF is size, not bargain; the 1999 building age adds maintenance/resale drag. Hillview is a quiet, low-liquidity D23 pocket 810m from DT3. At $1.59M absolute the entry is reasonable and freehold. Good fundamentals offset by age and location softness.
red_flags: oversized 1,270 sqft 2BR — cheap PSF partly reflects size
810m to MRT in a low-liquidity Hillview pocket
catalysts: freehold at -19% to URA median — clear value
Hillview's green, low-density appeal supports owner-occupier demand
